description: Standardize loading states across the app by creating a unified loading component system. Currently there's inconsistent usage of ActivityIndicator, LoadingSpinner (Lottie), skeleton loaders, and TraktLoadingSpinner.

phases.name: Create Core Unified Loading Components
phases.description: Build the foundational unified loading component system with multiple variants: spinner, skeleton, and full-screen loading states

subtasks.title: Create unified loading types and constants
subtasks.description: Create TypeScript types and constants for the unified loading system including LoadingVariant, LoadingSize, and common props interfaces
acceptance_criteria: LoadingVariant type defined (spinner, skeleton, shimmer, branded)
Common props interface with text, size, style, testID
Color tokens for loading states from theme
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/loading/types.ts with all required types and constants: LoadingVariant, LoadingSize, BaseLoadingProps, SpinnerLoadingProps, SkeletonLoadingProps, SkeletonGroupProps, SkeletonPreset, LoadingOverlayProps, LoadingColorTokens interface with getLoadingColorTokens helper, animation duration constants, and responsive breakpoint utilities.

subtasks.title: Create UnifiedSpinner component
subtasks.description: Create a theme-aware spinner component that replaces ActivityIndicator usage with consistent styling. Supports Lottie animations and fallback to native spinner.
acceptance_criteria: Optional loading text with proper styling
Lottie animation support with fallback to ActivityIndicator
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/loading/UnifiedSpinner.tsx with: theme-aware spinner (uses currentTheme.colors.primary), three sizes (small/medium/large), Lottie animation with fallback to ActivityIndicator, Android-specific Lottie configuration, optional loading text with responsive styling, custom Lottie source prop, accessibility support.

subtasks.title: Create ShimmerSkeleton component
subtasks.description: Create a reusable shimmer skeleton component extracted from MetadataLoadingScreen that can be used for any content placeholder
acceptance_criteria: Shared shimmer progress for synchronized animations
Support for both fixed dimensions and percentage widths
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/loading/ShimmerSkeleton.tsx with: animated shimmer effect using react-native-reanimated (useSharedValue, useAnimatedStyle, withRepeat, withTiming, interpolate), configurable width/height/borderRadius props, theme-aware colors via getLoadingColorTokens, useShimmerProgress hook for synchronized animations, support for both fixed dimensions and percentage widths. Includes comprehensive JSDoc documentation and examples.

subtasks.title: Create SkeletonGroup component
subtasks.description: Create a component that renders multiple skeleton elements with synchronized shimmer animation, useful for list placeholders
acceptance_criteria: Accepts count prop for number of skeleton items
Shared shimmer animation progress across all children
Preset configurations for common patterns (list, grid, text block)
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/loading/SkeletonGroup.tsx with: (1) count prop for number of skeleton items, (2) shared shimmer animation via useShimmerProgress hook, (3) preset configurations for list/grid/textBlock/poster/episode/cast/catalogRow, (4) configurable gap between items, (5) staggered fade-in animation option, (6) custom renderItem function. Also includes CastSkeletonGroup, EpisodeSkeletonGroup, and CatalogRowSkeletonGroup specialized components with comprehensive JSDoc documentation.

subtasks.title: Create LoadingOverlayScreen component
subtasks.description: Create a full-screen loading overlay component for page-level loading states with optional backdrop and branding
acceptance_criteria: Centered spinner with optional loading message
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/loading/LoadingOverlayScreen.tsx with: (1) Full-screen semi-transparent overlay using Modal, (2) Centered UnifiedSpinner with optional loading message via text prop, (3) SafeArea support via useSafeAreaInsets hook from react-native-safe-area-context, (4) Optional backdrop blur effect using BlurView from expo-blur (iOS only, solid fallback on Android), (5) Theme-aware colors via getLoadingColorTokens and currentTheme, (6) Smooth fade-in/fade-out animations using react-native-reanimated (withTiming, useAnimatedStyle, runOnJS for cleanup), (7) Dismissable via onBackdropPress callback, (8) Configurable backdropOpacity and size props. Includes comprehensive JSDoc documentation with usage examples.

subtasks.title: Create ContentSkeleton presets
subtasks.description: Create preset skeleton configurations for common content types: poster card, episode card, cast member, catalog row
acceptance_criteria: CastSkeleton - circular avatar with name placeholder
CatalogRowSkeleton - title bar + horizontal poster row
Responsive sizing based on device dimensions
subtasks.notes: Created src/components/loading/ContentSkeleton.tsx with specialized skeleton components matching actual content component dimensions: (1) PosterSkeleton - matches ContentItem with 2:3 aspect ratio and responsive width (100-140px based on device), (2) EpisodeSkeleton - matches EpisodeCard layout (120px height horizontal card with thumbnail and info section), (3) CastSkeleton - circular avatar with name/character placeholders matching CastSection dimensions (80-100px based on device), (4) CatalogRowSkeleton - title bar + horizontal poster row matching HomeScreen structure. Bonus components: EpisodeListSkeleton, CastRowSkeleton, PosterGridSkeleton for complete coverage. All components use responsive sizing based on device type (phone/tablet/largeTablet/tv) using getDeviceType helper from types.ts.

subtasks.title: Create index barrel export
subtasks.description: Create an index file that exports all loading components for easy importing
subtasks.notes: Created index.ts barrel export file for unified loading components. Exports all types, constants, utility functions, core components (UnifiedSpinner, ShimmerSkeleton, SkeletonGroup, LoadingOverlayScreen), content-specific skeletons (PosterSkeleton, EpisodeSkeleton, CastSkeleton, CatalogRowSkeleton, EpisodeListSkeleton, CastRowSkeleton, PosterGridSkeleton), and the useShimmerProgress hook.
